name: Do I need to be present during countertop installation?
description: Being present at the start and end of installation is recommended for discussions and a final walkthrough.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be present during countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not always strictly necessary for you to be present for the entire duration of the installation, we recommend being available at the beginning to discuss any last-minute details with the installers and at the end for a final walkthrough. This ensures your satisfaction with the completed work. We serve clients in Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito and will communicate scheduling clearly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Being present at the start and end of installation is recommended for discussions and a final walkthrough.
